analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.21) vs SMA5 ($0.22)/SMA20 ($0.24)/SMA50 ($0.23): below short/mid-term trends, indicating weak positioning.
· Position vs SMA100 ($0.21)/SMA200 ($0.21): near long-term support, maintaining bearish strength.
· 52-week position (13.7%) + current price range historically low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.6→38.4) + entered oversold territory, confirming downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0035→-0.0050) + continued weakness, maintaining downtrend post-death cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (lower band $0.21) + 23.95% band width suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.19) + based on Pivot S1 level.
· Swing resistance ($0.23) + based on SMA50 and Bollinger Band middle band levels.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (no higher low, no lower high: sideways) + lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.62) + subdued conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + observe support level on further decline, resistance breakout on bounces.
